story.originalTitle: Five ways F1 can fix the Madring for next year's Spanish GP
story.summaryEn: Formula 1's long-awaited return to Madrid left fans wanting due to a lack of action, although the Madring venue itself staged a respectable event. The article outlines five ways organisers could improve the race for its second year.
detailZh: F1修复马德里赛道、迎接明年西班牙大奖赛的五种方法
马德里赛道的首次F1亮相或许在赛场之外取得了成功，但比赛中缺乏精彩对抗，招致了大量批评，也为明年的西班牙大奖赛留下了许多反馈
备受期待的F1重返马德里因比赛缺乏精彩对抗而让车迷们感到意犹未尽，不过马德里赛道本身举办了一场相当体面的赛事。以下是主办方在第二年改进这项赛事的五种方法
总体而言，作为一场首次举办的赛事，马德里45年来的首场F1比赛进行得相当顺利。主办方计划充分利用IFEMA会展中心现有的设施，以及其便捷的公共交通和巴拉哈斯国际机场的交通条件
初步迹象表明，这项计划执行得相当不错，在一座城市中心举办的大型观赛活动中，几乎没有出现通常伴随而来的种种糟糕情况。除了要应付少数过于严苛的保安或警察之外，可容纳11万人的观众进出场地都相当顺畅。
但F1首先是一项赛车运动，因此马德里赛道最需要做好的核心项目就是赛道上的比赛产品。而这方面却差强人意。虽然排位赛颇具观赏性，但这条5.4公里长的赛道尽管是从一张白纸全新设计而来，却完全没有提供任何超车机会。
车手们对超车机会的匮乏感到不满。
马德里赛道之所以呈现如今的面貌，有很多原因。围绕展览馆群的南部区域天然受限，因为必须绕行现有的高大展览大厅。北部专门建造的部分虽然是全新设计，但IFEMA主办方考虑到未来的展馆和展览会，只能使用空地的其中一部分。再加上层层叠叠的官僚程序，建造一条城市赛道绝非易事。
但这并不能成为最终交付的这条赛道的借口。正如一位车手在看到设计的早期效果图时所说的那样：“这里根本不可能有超车。”
在赛事主办方和国际汽联着手为未来进行改进之际，以下是针对2027年改进这条赛道的五条建议。
马德里赛道最令人恼火的一点，是它坚持采用合并式弯道入口，车手必须在刹车的同时转向，两种作用力争夺轮胎有限的抓地力。这使得某些弯道非常别扭，也让前车很容易防守。
5号弯是最严重的问题，因为从图纸上来看，它是唯一一处能够真正自然发生超车的地方——它紧跟在第一个弯道组合之后最长的一段全油门直路之后。
但除了车辆并线入弯外，这个弯道宽度不足、路肩很高、紧贴护栏，这意味着想要超车几乎没有现实的可能，除非冒着被挤上护栏或被迫驶入沥青缓冲区的风险。
除了摩纳哥之外，大多数其他街道赛道至少都有一个超车机会。马德里赛道的弯道设计扼杀了这一点，据了解，根据车手和国际汽联的反馈，5号弯是2027年将进行重大改造的弯道之一。
狭窄而别扭的减速弯让超车几乎不可能。
营销宣传理所当然地聚焦于“纪念碑弯”，也就是12号弯那宏伟的倾斜弯道，它在F1赛历上是独一无二的。它在电视上看起来还不错，但远远没有体现出它的震撼。自由练习时站在环形弯的内侧，是赛历上最好的现场观赛体验之一，因为这个弯道拥有众多的横坡、半径和高度变化，使它有别于椭圆形赛道那种单一的倾斜弯道。
不过，主办方认为赛车在那里可以走不同线路的想法相当乐观，这个弯本身对比赛产品也没有增加多少价值。紧随其后的一段蛇形路段更是雪上加霜。13号弯是另一个90度的中速弯，护栏位置很别扭，导致完全无法超车。16号弯又是一个组合入口，而在最后几个通往终点大直道的弯角里，赛车只能排成纵队通过。
兰多·诺里斯建议绕过18号和19号弯，打造第二条长直道，然后在20号弯接一个发夹弯，并加宽弯道设计以允许不同的走线，或许还可以增加一些倾角。这还需要重新调整出口处的护栏，因为它们令人恼火地侵占了赛车线。
IFEMA作为场地的一大优势同时也是某种弱点。这个地方太庞大了。这让车队更方便运入和运出物资，给了他们充足的工作空间，甚至未来几年还可以增加其他活动——这些活动在其他地方根本不会有足够的空间。
但在场地内走动非常麻烦，尤其对像迈凯伦这样位于维修区尽头、工程区和接待区之间距离巨大的车队来说更是如此。这让公关团队整个周末都变成了高尔夫球车司机，但并非人人都有车接送。希望这个场地的巨大面积不只是被用来塞进更多贵宾和名人——周日的情形已经给人这种感觉了。
IFEMA场地过于庞大在赛道上也带来了后果。540米长的维修区通道不仅特别长，而且由于既有建筑的限制，中间还设有一段100米的分隔。
由于这场比赛演变成了一场相对简单的一停战术，如此漫长的维修区通道只会进一步打消车队尝试其他策略的念头。当超车几乎不可能时，策略上的差异是唯一能引发超车或为比赛增添看点的方式——除非寄希望于红旗和安全车。
尽管马德里展馆区域是一个极具特色的地标，但赛道其余部分却让人感觉可以位于世界上任何地方。
前车手、如今的评论员兼赛道设计师亚历山大·伍尔兹的说明最为到位。“当我看着这些混凝土通道时，有时候我甚至不知道自己身处哪条街道赛道，”伍尔兹对奥地利广播电台（ORF）说。“我是在澳大利亚，是在瓦伦西亚，还是在马德里？我到底在哪里？
“它们看起来总是千篇一律。这意味着我没能在这么酷的场合代表我的主办城市。其实有很多可以发挥的空间。”
虽然令人心跳加速的拉蒙特门塔尔大弯道是一次成功的加入，但马德里赛道的许多区域看起来毫无特色。
放大视角的转播镜头让马德里赛道的情况雪上加霜，而且要让围绕混凝土展览馆的 比赛（比赛）看起来有吸引力本来就很困难。但一定有办法让人们感觉身处于马德里。否则，这一切的意义何在？
还需要更加用心地改善观众的视线，因为我们收到了大量车迷的投诉：由于混凝土护栏的摆放位置，他们坐在昂贵的大看台座位上却被挡住看不到赛车。这个问题对于明年来说相对容易解决，但遗憾的是起初没能避免。
对马德里赛道来说，最重要的事情是体面地度过第一年。组织方在时间安排上面临很大压力，因此重点放在做好充分准备、为观众提供顺畅且安全的体验上。随着首秀顺利完成，马德里赛道可以开始思考如何整体提升车迷体验。
一些车迷区和普通入场区域看起来空荡荡的，细节也比较粗糙。设计方仿照了蒙扎那种俯瞰主直道的大型颁奖台，但没有能力或信心允许车迷像典型的意大利大奖赛那样冲进赛道、真正参与到庆祝之中。正如其他分站发生的意外所表明的，冲进赛道并不容易保障安全，所以第一年组织方保持谨慎是可以理解的。
只有少数车迷能够参与颁奖台庆祝活动，因为组织方在第一年选择了稳妥行事。
无论是在赛道上还是赛道外，马德里赛道都有很多机会提升自己的水准，而为期10年的合同也给了它足够的喘息空间，让它有望成为赛历上深受喜爱的组成部分。
“这只是第一步，”赛事常务董事路易斯·加西亚·阿巴德在比赛结束后接受Motorsport.com采访时说道。“我们在观众和接待方面取得了巨大成功，现在我们对未来几年有很多想法。”
“我们有空间，有场地，有设施，也有能力做到这一点。我相信一级方程式管理公司、国际汽联和我们自己都会去努力。如果有什么可以改进的地方，我们就会去做。”
detailEn: Five ways F1 can fix the Madring for next year's Spanish GP
The Madring's Formula 1 debut may have been an off-track success, but its lack of action has triggered plenty of criticism and feedback for next year's Spanish Grand Prix

F1's much-anticipated return to Madrid has left fans of the series wanting due to a lack of action, though the Madring venue itself put on a respectable event. Here are five ways organisers could improve the event for year two.

By and large, Madrid's first F1 race in 45 years ran particularly smooth for a first-time event. The organisers planned to capitalise on the IFEMA fairgrounds' existing facilities and their easy access to public transportation and to the Barajas International Airport.

Early indications are that that plan worked rather well, with few if any of the typical horror stories accompanying a mass spectator event in the middle of a city. Other than dealing with a few overzealous security guards or police officers, the 110,000 capacity crowd was able to get in and out of the venue rather smoothly.

But F1 is a motor race first and foremost, so the biggest ticket item the Madring needed to get right was its on-track product. It left a lot to be desired. While qualifying was an enticing spectacle, the 5.4km circuit offered zero overtaking opportunities despite being drawn up from a blank sheet of paper.
Drivers were left unimpressed with the lack of overtaking opportunities.

There are plenty of reasons why the Madring circuit is the way it is. The southern part around the complex is inherently limited because of the existing, towering exhibition halls which need navigating around. The northern, purpose-built part was a blank sheet design, but IFEMA organisers could only use a part of the empty plot of land of the track with future pavilions and expositions in mind. Add in the layers of bureaucracy involved, and building an urban race circuit is no easy feat.
But that's no excuse for the circuit that was eventually delivered. As one racing driver put it when he saw an early mock-up of the design: "There's not going to be any overtaking here."
As organisers and the FIA work on improvements for the future, here are five suggestions to improve the venue for 2027.

The most annoying aspect of the Madring was its insistence on drawing combined corner entries, where drivers have to brake and steer at the same time, both forces competing for a limited amount of tyre grip. It made certain corners very awkward and also made it easy for the car in front to defend.
Turn 5 is the worst offender, because on paper it was the only spot where overtaking could actually happen organically, following the longest flat/out section coming out of the first corner sequence.

But alongside the combined entry, the corner's lack of width, presence of high kerbs and proximity of the walls meant there was no realistic way to pass without risking being put into the wall or forced through the asphalt runoff area.

Other than Monaco, most other street circuits feature at least one passing opportunity. Madrid's corner design thwarted that, and it is understood Turn 5 is one of the corner that will undergo significant changes for 2027 following feedback by the drivers and the FIA.
Narrow, awkward chicanes made overtaking all but impossible.

Marketing efforts understandably focused on La Monumental, the majestic banking in Turn 12 which is unique on the F1 calendar. It looked okay on TV, but that didn't nearly do it justice. Standing on the inside of the loop in free practice was one of the better trackside thrills on the calendar because of the corner's many camber, radius and elevation changes that set it apart from an oval-style baking.

Organisers were rather optimistic to think that cars could take different lines through there, though, and the corner didn't add much value to the racing product itself. Its cause wasn't helped by the snaking section that followed. Turn 13 was another 90-degree medium-speed corner with awkward barrier placement that didn't allow for any passing. Turn 16 had another combined entry, while it was single-file through the final few corners towards the finish straight.

Lando Norris suggested a bypass of Turns 18 and 19 to create a second long straight followed by a hairpin in Turn 20, widening its design to allow different approaches, perhaps adding some camber, too. That would also involve realigning the exit barriers, as they annoyingly encroached on the racing line.

One of IFEMA's biggest advantages as a venue was also somewhat of a weakness. The place is enormous. That made it easier for teams to ship freight in and out and gave them plenty of space to work, and perhaps even add other activities in following years that they would never have the space for elsewhere.

But getting around was cumbersome, especially for a team like McLaren which was at the far end of the pitlane, creating a massive distance between its engineering hubs and hospitality units. It turned PR teams into golf car drivers for the weekend, but not everyone was as lucky to be ferried around. Hopefully the ground's massive size isn't just used to cram even more VIPs and celebrities into the venue, which already felt the case on Sunday.
There's also an on-track consequence to IFEMA's vast size. The 540-metre pitlane was not only particularly long, but also featured a 100-metre split in the middle dictated by existing buildings.

With the race turning into a relatively straightforward one-stopper, having such a long pitlane only further discouraged teams from attempting alternative strategies. When overtaking is almost impossible, strategic variance is the only way to induce it or otherwise spice up the race - short of hoping for red flags and safety cars.
As much as La Monumental was a distinctive landmark, the rest of the circuit felt like it could have been anywhere in the world.

Former driver and now pundit and track designer Alex Wurz explained it best. "When I look at this concrete channel, at some point I wouldn't know which street circuit I'm on anymore," Wurz told ORF. "Am I in Australia, am I in Valencia, am I in Madrid, where am I?
"They all always look the same. That means I'm not representing my host city in such a cool way. There's quite a lot you could do there."
While the hair-raising La Monumental banking was a successful addition, many areas of the Madring circuit looked nondescript.

The Madring's case wasn't helped by the zoomed-in viewing angles and it was always going to be tricky to make racing around concrete exhibition halls look attractive. But there has to be a way to make people feel they are in Madrid. Otherwise, what is the point?

More care also needs to be taken to improve sightlines for spectators, as we received plenty of complaints from fans being blocked from seeing the cars from their expensive grandstand seats because of the concrete barrier placement. That's an issue that's relatively straightforward to resolve for next year, but it's a shame it couldn't have been prevented to begin with.

For Madrid, the most important thing was to get through year one respectably. The organisers were up against it in terms of timelines, so the focus was on being ready to provide a smooth and safe experience. With its debut out of the way, the Madring can start thinking about elevating the fan experience in general.

Some fan zones and general admission areas looked sparse and rough around the edges. Designers copied Monza's sprawling podium overlooking the main straight, but weren't able or confident to allow for a typical Italian GP style track invasion for fans to actually be part of the celebration. As shown by incidents at other races, a track invasion is not easy to pull off, so it's understandable why organisers have been prudent in year one.
Only few fans were able to take part in the podium celebrations as organisers played it safe in year one.

Both on and off the track, there are plenty of opportunities for the Madring to step up its game, and its 10-year contract is giving it the breathing room to do so and become a beloved part of the calendar.

"This is the first step," the race's managing director Luis Garcia Abad told Motorsport.com after the race. "We had a big success in terms of public and hospitality, and now we have a lot of ideas for the next few years.
"We have the space, we have a venue, we have the facilities, we have the capacity to do it. I'm sure that FOM, FIA, and ourselves, we will try. If we can improve something, we will do it."

relatedItems.originalTitle: Toyota denies 2027 WEC deal with Esteban Ocon
relatedItems.summaryEn: Toyota has denied it will sign Esteban Ocon for the World Endurance Championship in 2027, saying it does not want to jeopardise the harmony within its driver lineups. This follows Haas officially announcing it will end its partnership with the 30-year-old Frenchman at the conclusion of the 2026 season.
detailZh: 丰田否认2027年与奥孔达成WEC协议
这家日本制造商不想破坏其车手阵容内部的和谐
奥孔在F1的选择正逐渐减少，而丰田不会在世界耐力锦标赛（WEC）为他提供席位。
在哈斯车队本周官宣将在2026赛季结束后结束与这位30岁法国车手的合作之后，媒体上关于奥孔职业生涯下一步去向的猜测甚嚣尘上。
随着阿斯顿·马丁确认将继续留用阿隆索和斯特罗尔，凯迪拉克实际上成为奥孔在一级方程式中最后一个现实的选择。
这也正是他还与转投世界耐力锦标赛的可能性联系在一起的原因——可能加盟丰田。但丰田顾问亚历山大·伍尔茨现已向Motorsport.com姊妹刊物Formel1.de的YouTube频道明确表示：“这些传闻毫无根据。”
伍尔茨表示，丰田在勒芒及其世界耐力锦标赛项目上通常会做“相当长远的”规划，目前不打算对现有的六人车手阵容做出任何调整。
“因为当你把三个强势个性放进同一辆赛车时，他们需要时间去彼此接受，去找到正确的调校和正确的合作方式，并达到这样一个阶段：他们不再在内部互相竞争，而是真正激发出彼此的最佳状态。这是一个非常重要的区别，”这位奥地利人解释道。
#8 丰田Gazoo Racing 丰田TR010：塞巴斯蒂安·布耶米、布伦登·哈特利、平川亮
"这是丰田的优势之一：我们拥有这样的车队架构和车队文化，而这种东西不可能一夜之间改变。
"首先，我们签的是长期合同。其次，你不可能随便从外面引进一名车手，直接把他塞进车手阵容里。那样做恰恰有可能破坏我们自2012年以来一直建立并悉心呵护的文化。维护这种文化是我作为顾问、作为与车手密切合作的人的主要职责之一。
他还补充道："但不管你怎么看，这些合同都是长期的，而且我们明年的车手阵容已经百分之百满了。"
丰田目前参加世界耐力锦标赛（WEC），一台车由迈克·康威、尼克·德弗里斯和小林可梦伟驾驶，另一台车由塞巴斯蒂安·布埃米、布伦登·哈特利和平川亮驾驶。这家日本厂商刚刚在家乡富士赛道赢得胜利，在惊心动魄的尾声中，本地英雄平川亮完成了决定胜负的最后一段驾驶。
detailEn: Toyota denies 2027 WEC deal with Esteban Ocon
The Japanese manufacturer doesn't want to jeopardise the harmony within its driver lineups
Esteban Ocon’s Formula 1 options are gradually running out, and Toyota will not provide one in the WEC.

After Haas officially announced this week that it will end its partnership with the 30-year-old Frenchman at the conclusion of the 2026 season, media speculation has been rife over where Ocon’s career might take him next.
With Aston Martin having confirmed that it will continue with Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll, Cadillac effectively remains Ocon's last realistic option in Formula 1.

That is why he has also been linked with a possible switch to the World Endurance Championship – potentially with Toyota. But Toyota advisor Alexander Wurz has now made it clear to Motorsport.com sister publication Formel1.de’s YouTube channel: "There's nothing to these rumours."
Wurz said that Toyota generally plans "relatively far ahead" when it comes to Le Mans and its WEC programme, and that no changes to its current six-driver line-up are planned.

"Because when you put three alpha personalities in one car, it takes time for them to accept each other, to find the right set-up and the right way of working together, and to reach a point where they don't compete against each other internally but actually bring out the best in one another. That's a very important distinction," the Austrian explained.
#8 Toyota Gazoo Racing Toyota TR010: Sebastien Buemi, Brendon Hartley, Ryo Hirakawa
"That's one of Toyota's strengths: we have this team structure and this team culture, and you can't simply change that overnight.

"First of all, we have long-term contracts. And secondly, you can't just bring in another driver from the outside and slot him into the line-up. That would risk disrupting exactly the culture we've been building and nurturing since 2012. Maintaining that culture is one of my main responsibilities as an advisor and someone who works closely with the drivers.
He added: "But whichever way you look at it, the contracts are long-term and our line-up for next year is 100% full."

Toyota currently competes in the WEC with Mike Conway, Nyck de Vries and Kamui Kobayashi in one car, and Sebastien Buemi, Brendon Hartley and Ryo Hirakawa in the other. The Japanese manufacturer has just won its home race at Fuji, following a thrilling finish with local hero Hirakawa at the wheel for the decisive stint.

relatedItems.originalTitle: Honda secretly introduced second F1 ADUO upgrade in Madrid
relatedItems.summaryEn: Honda Racing Corporation president Koji Watanabe has revealed that Honda introduced its second ADUO (Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities) upgrade as early as the Spanish Grand Prix, focusing on the power unit's turbocharger.
detailZh: 本田秘密在马德里引入第二个F1 ADUO升级
本田赛车公司（HRC）透露，本田本赛季F1的第二个ADUO升级是新的涡轮增压器，早在西班牙大奖赛就已引入。
本田赛车公司社长渡边浩司透露，本田实际上早在F1西班牙大奖赛就引入了第二个额外开发与升级机会升级，重点针对动力单元的涡轮增压器。
阿斯顿·马丁和本田从赛季开始时表现挣扎，但在亨格罗林引入重大底盘升级后表现略有改善。在赞德沃特，车队还引入了搭载第一个ADUO升级的动力单元。
据测量，本田的内燃机（ICE）比红牛福特动力总成的引擎落后超过4%，后者被评为输出功率最高的引擎，这意味着本田获准在赛季中使用两个空气动力学升级配额令牌。
本田和HRC此前曾解释说，他们只会使用其中一次ADUO机会。“我们两次都用了，”渡边在接受Motorsport.com网站采访时透露，当时他被问到为什么本田决定只使用一次ADUO升级。
“我们在荷兰引入了第一次ADUO升级，然后在西班牙大奖赛上，我们把一套包含第二次升级的动力单元装到了斯特罗尔的车上。
“我们在荷兰引入的2号规格动力单元存在一些可驾驶性问题，所以我们在西班牙大奖赛上引入了一个改进版的涡轮增压器。”
事实上，国际汽联的动力单元部件使用清单显示，斯特罗尔的赛车在西班牙大奖赛时已经用上了本赛季的第五个涡轮增压器。费尔南多·阿隆索的赛车也在阿塞拜疆大奖赛装上了第五个涡轮增压器，而这看起来就是升级版本。
当被问及目标是否是解决涡轮迟滞问题时，渡边回答说：“是的。”他随后解释了分阶段引入升级部件的思路。
“如果我们能一次性把所有东西都引入当然更好，但首先在荷兰引入规格2（Spec 2）非常重要。与此同时，我们也在研究解决涡轮迟滞的对策，所以在西班牙引入了这部分。
“因此，应用最终被分成了两部分。”
不过渡边也表示，本田仍未完全发挥其动力单元的全部潜力。
本田此前为红牛供应引擎时，不被允许引入性能升级，但仍继续利用模拟来确定动力单元的运行极限，并逐年逐步提高这些极限。这就是本田所说的“可靠性研发”。
例如，红牛在2024年采用了极其窄小的侧箱，同时也缩小了用于引入冷却气流的开口尺寸。这也得益于提高动力单元的运行极限才得以实现。
“就ADUO而言，我们已经用完了本赛季的升级机会。从这里开始，我们将继续在不涉及硬件的方面下功夫，同时也进行面向未来发展的研发。”渡边说道。
我认为我们距离完全发挥这套动力单元的全部性能还很远。我相信它的竞争力仍有提升空间。
此前仍有一些地方存在动力不足，因此我们带着明确的目标数值开发了第二版规格。我们已经达成了这些目标，所以在赛季剩余的时间里，我们的重点将放在充分利用现有成果上，而不是继续开发硬件。
即便如此，我们仍要确保自己能够真正地进行竞争。
detailEn: Honda secretly introduced second F1 ADUO upgrade in Madrid
Honda's second ADUO upgrade of the F1 season was a new turbocharger, already introduced at the Spanish Grand Prix, HRC reveals

Honda Racing Corporation president Koji Watanabe has revealed that Honda actually introduced its second ADUO (Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities) upgrade as early as Formula 1’s Spanish Grand Prix, with the upgrade focused on the power unit's turbocharger.

Aston Martin and Honda struggled from the start of the season, but their performance slightly improved after a major chassis upgrade was introduced at the Hungaroring. In Zandvoort, the team also introduced a power unit fitted with the first ADUO upgrade.

Honda's ICE was measured to be more than 4% behind the Red Bull Ford Powertrains engine, which was rated as having the highest output, meaning Honda was granted permission to use two ADUO tokens during the season.

Honda and HRC had previously explained that they would use only one of those ADUO opportunities. “We used both of them,” Watanabe revealed to Motorsport.com when asked why Honda had decided to use only one ADUO upgrade.
“We introduced the first ADUO upgrade in the Netherlands, and then we put a PU incorporating the second update into Lance Stroll's car at the Spanish Grand Prix.
“The Spec 2 PU we introduced in the Netherlands had some drivability issues, so we introduced an improved turbo at the Spanish Grand Prix.”

Indeed, the FIA's list of PU component usage shows that Stroll's car was fitted with its fifth turbocharger of the season at the Spanish GP. Fernando Alonso's car was also fitted with his fifth turbo, which would appear to be the upgraded version, at the Azerbaijan GP.
Asked whether the objective was to address turbo lag, Watanabe replied: “Yes.” He subsequently explained the thinking behind the staggered introduction of the upgrades.

“It would have been better if we could have introduced everything at once, but it was important to introduce Spec 2 in the Netherlands first. We were also working on measures to address the turbo lag in parallel, so we introduced that in Spain.
“So the application ended up being split between the two.”
Watanabe also said, however, that Honda is still not extracting the full potential of its power unit.

When Honda was previously supplying Red Bull, it was not allowed to introduce performance upgrades, but it continued to use simulations to determine the operating limits of the PU and gradually raise those limits year after year. This was what Honda referred to as “reliability development”.

For example, Red Bull adopted extremely small sidepods in 2024, while also reducing the size of the openings used to draw in airflow for cooling. This was also made possible by raising the PU's operating limits.

“As far as ADUO is concerned, we have used up our opportunities for this season. From here, we will continue working on things that don't involve hardware, as well as developments that will lead into the future”, Watanabe said.
“I don't think we are anywhere near extracting the full performance of the PU. I believe there is still room to improve its competitiveness.

“There were still areas where we were lacking power, so we developed Spec 2 with target figures in mind. We have achieved those targets, so for the remainder of the season, our focus will be on making full use of what we have, rather than continuing to develop the hardware.
“Even so, we want to make sure we are able to fight properly.”

在赞德沃特，车队还引入了搭载第一个ADUO升级的动力单元。
渡边浩司是本田赛车公司的社长。
keyPointsEn: Aston Martin and Honda struggled from the start of the season, but performance slightly improved after a major chassis upgrade at the Hungaroring.
In Zandvoort, the team also introduced a power unit fitted with the first ADUO upgrade.

Horner told The Times that working with Ferrari would be "the dream" and the only team where he would accept a non-ownership role at this stage of his career.
detailZh: 京特·施泰纳调侃克里斯蒂安·霍纳与法拉利的传闻是给书做宣传
京特·施泰纳否认了克里斯蒂安·霍纳与弗雷德·瓦塞尔在法拉利共事的可能性
前哈斯一级方程式车队领队京特·施泰纳认为克里斯蒂安·霍纳和弗雷德·瓦塞尔在法拉利并肩工作的可能性不大。
关于霍纳未来去向的猜测在其接受《泰晤士报》采访后升温。霍纳表示他愿意考虑在马拉内罗车队担任领导职务。霍纳称与法拉利合作是"梦想"，并表示在他职业生涯的这个阶段，法拉利是他唯一愿意接受非所有者职位的车队。
在《红旗播客》节目中，施泰纳表示，霍纳只是在调整自己的策略，以求重返争冠行列，还打趣说他可能是想为自己的新书做些宣传。
“我认为克里斯蒂安想回到一级方程式，而且他说得很清楚，他不想再为任何人打工了。显然，他的A计划行不通，于是他就转向B计划，而如果他去了法拉利工作，就拿不到那里的股份，”施泰纳说。“我认为他想进去，并且他在那里看到了一个机会。”
他补充道：“另外，这对他来说也没有什么坏处。他要出一本书，这会有助于那本书的销售，或者也许没帮助，我们不知道，但至少算是有一点宣传。”
施泰纳还回应了关于霍纳与瓦塞尔在法拉利共事的问题，并否定了这种可能性。
"我认为弗雷德留在那里为克里斯蒂安工作的情况不会发生,"他说。"弗雷德本人是一个非常成功的人。但首先,我不知道弗雷德是否想离开,或者他是否不得不离开。
"说到底,弗雷德手上有一份合同,而在一级方程式里这些合同又值多少钱呢?我猜并不多,但那里没有容纳他们两个人的空间。这就是我的看法。那种情况不会发生。"
detailEn: Guenther Steiner jokes Christian Horner Ferrari talk is good book publicity
Guenther Steiner has dismissed the prospect of Christian Horner and Fred Vasseur working together at Ferrari
Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner has dismissed the possibility of Christian Horner and Fred Vasseur working alongside each other at Ferrari.

Speculation regarding Horner's future intensified after he told The Times he would consider a leadership role at the Maranello outfit. Horner described working with Ferrari as "the dream" and indicated it is the only team at which he would accept a non-ownership position at this stage of his career.
Speaking on The Red Flags Podcast, Steiner suggested Horner is simply adapting his strategy to return to the championship and joked that he could be getting some publicity for his new book.

"I think Christian wants to come back to Formula 1, and he said clearly that he doesn't want to work for anybody anymore. Obviously, plan A for him doesn't work out, so he goes to plan B and he doesn't get a stake in Ferrari if he goes to work there," Steiner said. "I think he wants to come in and he sees an opportunity there."

He added: "The other thing, there's nothing bad for him in it as well. He's releasing a book so it will help the sale of that one, or maybe not, we don't know, but at least it's a little bit of publicity."
Steiner also addressed questions about Horner and Vasseur working together at Ferrari and dismissed the possibility.

"I don't think that's going to happen that Fred is staying there working for Christian," he said. "Fred in himself is a very successful guy. But first of all, I don't know that Fred wants to leave or that he has to leave.
"In the end, Fred has got a contract and how much are they worth in Formula 1? Not a lot, I guess, but there is not space for the two of them. That's my opinion on it. That is not going to happen."
